svg.title: Every Pantry report comes from one cache
svg.desc: A single SQLite file holds the OSV records for what is here, which versions were asked and when, the latest findings, every scan, the exposures with first-seen, last-seen and resolved scans, the fixes --update ran and the events. From it come the terminal report and exit code, the --json envelope, export --csv and --jsonl, wpantry report's exposure, remediation and audit logs in Markdown, JSON or CSV, search over the cached advisories, and the HTML report.
svg.text: Every report comes from one cache
~/.cache/wpantry/wpantry.db holds the history; each report is a view of it.
The terminal report grouped by kind; exit 0 clean, 1 fails, 2 usage, 3 internal.
--json: the schema 1 envelope agents and W read.
--csv: one row per finding. --jsonl: each finding with its OSV record,
lifecycle and fix outcome; --all adds the exposures later scans resolved.
as Markdown, JSON or CSV: evidence for SOC 2 CC7 and CC8.
Rank the cached advisories with FTS5;
--applicable keeps those in the latest findings.
One offline page: what was scanned, what is at risk,
what can be patched, what was, and what to do by hand.
Nothing is sent anywhere: a report is a file you keep or hand to an auditor. A scan with an unchecked source resolves no exposure and verifies no fix.
